about: Raimondo & Sundquist LLP keeps offices on Washington Street in Buffalo and on East Fifth Street in Jamestown, ninety minutes down the lake in Chautauqua County, and names three attorneys. Its front door presents estate and divorce work together, and it publishes a page on LGBTQ+ legal services.

21 reviews at 5.0 across both offices. Its domain was registered in 2021, which is a lower bound on the practice and not its age. It explains five stages of a matrimonial case, describes two routes through one, names the state bar association, and publishes no fee.
